aNMJ-morph+ v0.1.0

Requires Fiji: https://fiji.sc/

1. Copy anmj-morph-plus-0.1.0.jar into Fiji's plugins/ folder.
2. Restart Fiji.
3. Run Analyze > Tools > aNMJ-morph+.

To crop, draw a rectangle and click Continue. With no selection, the full image is used.
For images without calibration, use pixels or enter microns per pixel.
Calibrated ND2/CZI/LSM/LIF images keep physical units through projection and crop.
Only uncalibrated or unit-ambiguous images require a scale confirmation.
The channel prompt remembers the previous muscle and nerve selections.
During thresholding, compare the raw image on the left with the working image on the right.
Measure axon widths in order: maximum, minimum, hillock. Press M after each line.
The brush starts at 12 px unless you have a saved size. Double-click its icon to adjust.
Automatic endplate segmentation shows white clusters on black background.
Clear narrow necks may be automatically separated; ring holes are preserved.
No manual drawing is required for cluster separation.
Uncheck Image looks OK if needed.
Processing begins at 0% after axon cleanup and advances only after nerve,
skeleton, endplate, segmentation, counting and export stages actually complete.
100% requires verifying the saved TIFF and CSV outputs and finishing cleanup.
Cancellation or failure does not claim a successful 100% completion.
Only the original endplate and segmented preview appear at confirmation.
After confirmation, the plugin rapidly counts the segmented components and saves
the segmentation TIFF and CSV. Automated splits are conservative estimates.
